notTranslated: Qayb ka mid ah boggan weli lama turjumin, sidaa darteed waxaa lagu muujiyey Ingiriisi.

index.title: Glaze caan ah
index.lead: Glaze adduunka oo dhan laga yaqaan, mid kasta oo laga sameeyey walxihiisa dhaqameed ee deegaanka, oo leh UMF-tiisa iyo nooc laga sameeyey walxaha laga iibiyo meesha aad joogto.
index.more: Glaze kale ayaa imanaya: mid kasta waxaa lagu daraa marka habkiisa iyo walxihiisu ku saleysan yihiin ugu yaraan saddex ilood oo la akhriyey.

glaze.lead: Glaze caan ah ({native}): habkiisa dhaqameed ama falanqayn, gubiddiisa, iyo nooc laga sameeyey walxaha laga iibiyo meesha aad joogto.
glaze.historyOnly: Taariikh keliya: glaze-kan waxaa lagu sameeyey rasaas (lead, Pb). Falanqayntiisa waxaa loo muujiyey taariikh ahaan, ma aha hab la isku daro. Nooca hoose waa glaze kale, aan rasaas lahayn.

local.heading: Walxaha deegaankaaga
local.intro: UMF-ta habka dhaqameed, oo laga sameeyey walxaha caadiga ah ee laga iibiyo meesha aad wax ka iibsato. Dooro meesha aad wax ka iibsato si aad u aragto.
local.untested: Waa la xisaabiyey, weli tijaabo ahaan looma gubin.
local.testFirst: Gub test tile ka hor intaadan u isticmaalin weel kasta, oo tijaabi dusha cuntadu taabato in biraha ka soo baxaan (leaching).
local.untestedNote: Waa la xisaabiyey, weli tijaabo ahaan looma gubin: gub test tile ka hor isticmaalka.
local.close: Aad buu ugu dhow yahay qaacidada la beegsanayo.
local.fair: Si dhexdhexaad ah ayuu ugu dhow yahay qaacidada la beegsanayo.
local.poor: Walxahan uma dhowaan karaan qaacidada la beegsanayo.
local.none: Walxaha halkaas laga iibiyo ma sameyn karaan.
local.choose: Dooro meesha aad walxaha ka iibsato si aad u aragto isagoo laga sameeyey kuwa halkaas laga iibiyo.
